description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Runtime_CacheModify, which contains methods related to cache validation and HTTP header management within the Smarty templating engine's runtime. It primarily handles cache modification checks and HTTP response headers like 304 Not Modified and Last-Modified.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_CacheModify
classes.description: Class responsible for runtime cache modification logic, including checking client-side cache headers and handling HTTP response headers.

methods.name: cacheModifiedCheck
methods.description: Checks if the cached content has been modified since the client's last request and sends appropriate HTTP headers or outputs the content.
